character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A mysterious robed figure in a heavy, textured brown hooded cloak, standing in a wide, stable stance. The hood is pulled low, casting the face into deep shadow, revealing six glowing, piercing eyes arranged in a symmetrical pattern. The robe features intricate layered fabric folds and a frayed, worn hem, accented by a silver pentagram necklace. Instead of feet, four writhing black tentacles emerge from the base of the robe, providing a solid anchor. Selective outlines define the drapery and tentacle forms, captured from a low top-down 3/4 perspective.
